data.name: Bolster
data.description: As a standard action, you can touch an undead creature and infuse it with negative energy. It gains a + %1 profane bonus on all attack rolls and saving throws, as well as 1 temporary hit point per Hit Die and a +2 bonus to its turn resistance. These bonuses last for %2 rounds. The bonuses and temporary hit points are immediately dispelled if the creature is within the area of a consecrate spell. You can use this ability %3 times per day.|UndeadBolsterBonus|UndeadBolsterRounds|UndeadBolsterTimes
